unsupported_claims: The AI says node2vec tunes p and q on held-out validation data rather than by 10-fold cross-validation. The evidence states that the best in-out and return hyperparameters were learned using 10-fold cross-validation on 10% labeled data, which contradicts this.
rationale: The answer correctly declines to give the exact seed-averaged macro-F1 values, which the papers do not report, and its claims about Micro/Macro-F1 reporting and the labeled-fraction settings are supported. However, it wrongly says the paper tunes p and q without 10-fold cross-validation, when the evidence explicitly describes 10-fold cross-validation.
